raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Using direct Mooncake with Mooncake Store can fail in MultiConnector's metrics handler, and the Mooncake example proxy labels SSE responses as JSON, causing clients such as AIPerf to reject them. Fix both integration issues by respecting optional metrics exporters and returning the correct streaming Content-Type.

## Claims

- Skip children without Prometheus exporters while continuing to forward supported metrics and `engine_idx`.
- Return `text/event-stream` for streaming requests on `/v1/completions` and `/v1/chat/completions`; preserve JSON responses for non-streaming requests and forward response bytes unchanged.

```diff
 P transfer stats -> MultiConnector metrics
-  require an exporter for every child with stats
+  forward stats only to registered exporters

 D SSE frames -> Mooncake proxy -> client
-  Content-Type: application/json
+  Content-Type: text/event-stream
```

## Validation

```bash
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_multi_connector.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_mooncake_proxy.py \
  -k 'TestMultiConnectorStats or test_mooncake_proxy' -q
```

| Check | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stats-only child, with empty or mixed exporter registry | Both regression cases fail on main `c75cb63cd2bb` | All 17 stats cases pass |
| Real ASGI routes, completion/chat × streaming/non-streaming | 2 streaming cases fail on main `258b97ff6bc1`; 2 non-streaming cases pass | All 4 cases pass |
| Combined PR branch, based on `258b97ff6bc1` | — | **21 passed, 15 deselected** |

The metrics regression also checks that the supported child's payload reaches its exporter with `engine_idx=2`. The proxy regression mocks only the remote P/D calls and checks the actual response headers and bytes. In Buildkite, the V1 KV Connectors step runs the metrics regression. The proxy regression is CPU-only, so it is marked `cpu_test` and runs in the CPU V1 Others step, which also lists the proxy as a source dependency so proxy-only changes still trigger it.

Changed-file pre-commit checks pass:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pre_commit run --files \
  .buildkite/test_areas/misc.yaml \
  examples/disaggregated/mooncake_connector/mooncake_connector_proxy.py \
  vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/multi_connector.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_multi_connector.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_mooncake_proxy.py
```

Earlier ROCm end-to-end validation used integration commit `b41cf676db9cc124fffbcf305f7fa8c8d2f895b8`, containing the identical proxy file and metrics `observe()` implementation:

- [Before the proxy fix](https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM/actions/runs/38169410559): AIPerf attempted JSON parsing of SSE frames; all 13 sampled warmup responses were rejected.
- [C16 serving](https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM/actions/runs/38174661539): Kimi-K3 + DSpark3, 1P1D/16 MI355X, Mooncake RDMA + TCP Store completed a 3600-second performance window with 2006 successes and 4 errors. The workflow later failed while importing the separate GSM8K evaluator.
- [Natural GSM8K](https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM/actions/runs/38203116096): flexible extraction 1269/1319 (96.21%).

GPU evidence belongs to that integration revision; the current main-based PR branch has local regression coverage. Store lease timeouts and empty-response failures remain separate limitations. No additional GPU experiment was dispatched for this PR.

## Details

**Metrics:** `KVConnectorBase_V1.build_prom_metrics()` may return `None`. MultiConnector's metrics factory already excludes null exporters, while stats collection independently includes stats-only children. Direct Mooncake provides stats without an exporter, so its worker stats trigger the assertion in the API output handler. A conditional exporter lookup follows the existing optional-interface contract. Stats collection is unchanged; missing exporter IDs are skipped, so this assertion no longer detects inconsistent IDs in the metrics path.

**HTTP:** `_handle_completions` already forwards the request's streaming mode to D. Use the same flag to select the response media type. KV transfer and generation logic are unchanged.

The metrics portion follows up the **same fix proposed in #43836 for #43828**, adapted to the current flat stats payload with regression coverage. That PR remains open; this is not a distinct solution. The submitting operator explicitly requested including it here to cover both direct-Mooncake integration failures. Searches found no overlapping proxy SSE-header fix.

Both changes are reversible and scoped to metrics forwarding and the example proxy. AI assistance (Codex) was used; this remains a draft submitted at the human operator's request.

---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

</details>

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import asyncio
+import itertools
+import runpy
+from pathlib import Path
+from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
+
+import httpx
+import pytest
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.cpu_test
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("endpoint", ["/v1/completions", "/v1/chat/completions"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("stream", [False, True])
+async def test_response_media_type_matches_payload(monkeypatch, endpoint, stream):
+    """Clients must select SSE parsing for streaming completion responses."""
+    path = (
+        Path(__file__).parents[4]
+        / "examples/disaggregated/mooncake_connector/mooncake_connector_proxy.py"
+    )
+    proxy = runpy.run_path(str(path))["_handle_completions"].__globals__
+    app = proxy["app"]
+    app.state.ready = asyncio.Event()
+    app.state.ready.set()
+    app.state.prefill_iterator = itertools.cycle([({}, 0)])
+    app.state.decode_iterator = itertools.cycle([0])
+    app.state.decode_clients = [{}]
+    payload = b'{"choices":[{"text":"hello"}]}'
+    body = b"data: " + payload + b"\n\ndata: [DONE]\n\n" if stream else payload
+
+    async def decode_response(*args, **kwargs):
+        yield body
+
+    monkeypatch.setitem(proxy, "send_request_to_service", AsyncMock())
+    monkeypatch.setitem(proxy, "stream_service_response", decode_response)
+    async with httpx.AsyncClient(
+        transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://proxy"
+    ) as client:
+        response = await client.post(endpoint, json={"stream": stream})
+
+    expected_type = "text/event-stream" if stream else "application/json"
+    assert response.headers["content-type"].split(";")[0] == expected_type
+    assert response.content == body
